raw_support_spans.text: Multiple yellow to reddish brown firm papules and nodules were present on the scalp, face, neck, trunk, and limbs, including the axillae and inguinal regions.
Dense diffuse cellular infiltrate composed mainly of foamy histiocytic cells and multinucleated Touton cells mixed with lymphocytes and eosinophils.

response.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings are more consistent with Juvenile xanthogranuloma, which typically presents with yellow to reddish brown papules and nodules and has characteristic histopathological features, including foamy histiocytic cells and Touton cells.
